_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); hotel signals

pit_profile.why: Marriott: 'Consistent with our focus on management, franchising, and licensing, we own very few of our lodging properties'; 'We are a worldwide operator, franchisor, and licensor of hotel, residential, and timeshare properties in 127 countries and territories under 30 brand names'; 'Our industry is highly competitive, which may impact our ability to compete successfully with other hotel properties and home and apartment sharing services for guests'; 'Economic downturns could impact our financial results and growth'; 'An increase in the use of third-party Internet services to book online hotel reservations could adversely impact our business'; and 'Our 2017 full-year results reflected a year-over-year increase in the number of properties in our system, including those from the Starwood Combination, favorable demand for our brands in many markets around the world, and slow but steady economic growth' (its own FY2017 10-K): a hotel management and franchise system whose fees follow the revenues and profits of its hotels through the economy, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it

classification.quality_note: Marriott: 'Consistent with our focus on management, franchising, and licensing, we own very few of our lodging properties'; 'We are a worldwide operator, franchisor, and licensor of hotel, residential, and timeshare properties in 127 countries and territories under 30 brand names'; 'Our industry is highly competitive, which may impact our ability to compete successfully with other hotel properties and home and apartment sharing services for guests'; 'Economic downturns could impact our financial results and growth'; 'An increase in the use of third-party Internet services to book online hotel reservations could adversely impact our business'; and 'Our 2017 full-year results reflected a year-over-year increase in the number of properties in our system, including those from the Starwood Combination, favorable demand for our brands in many markets around the world, and slow but steady economic growth' (its own FY2017 10-K): a hotel management and franchise system whose fees follow the revenues and profits of its hotels through the economy, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 2.28x; +37% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.69; conservative 2yr -0%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -37.6%/yr (worst year FY08-FY17, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +7.3%/yr (FY18 fee guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +12.7%/yr (FY08-FY17 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +26.8%/yr (best 2-yr run FY08-FY17); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: MAR (retrospective, 2018-03-29) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 2.28x (70.6% downside to Bear $40 / +30.9% upside to Bull $178) | Adj composite 2.21 vs market 2.90: gap -0.69 [OVERVALUED] | +37% above the EPP floor $99 (19x FY18E $5.22) | Conservative 2-yr case: -0.1% total (-0.0%/yr) | At 26.0x FY18E the 15% hurdle price $180 sits above the BULL case; North American RevPAR +3.9% in Q4 2017, forward fee revenue +6.25-8.81% (FY18 fee revenue guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
